entities.name: UniProt B3DZZ7
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Methylacidiphilum infernorum phosphoglycerate mutase; 248 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
Catalyzes reversible interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and 3-phosphoglycerate (EC 5.4.2.11; Rhea RHEA:15901).
